title: Sanjay Chaurasiya v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi, J. and Praveen Kumar Giri, J.
disposition: Impugned rejection set aside; remitted to process commercial connection in accordance with law.
headnote: A tenant with a subsisting civil injunction had the Executive Engineer’s rejection of a temporary electricity connection set aside as covered by Guddi Kesarwani; the matter was remitted so that a commercial connection application would be processed in accordance with law.
facts: The petitioner has occupied a shop in the landlord’s house at E-26 Shantipuram, Phaphamau, Prayagraj since 2008, paying deposit and monthly rent, and runs a registered paneer business. After the landlord interfered with occupation and disconnected electricity, the Civil Judge (Junior Division), East Prayagraj, allowed his 6-C application in Suit No. 371 of 2024 and injuncted the landlord. The Executive Engineer, City Electricity Distribution Khand, Tagore Town, Prayagraj, nonetheless rejected his claim for a temporary electricity connection by order dated 16.07.2025.

holding_units.holding: Where a tenant’s occupation is protected by a subsisting civil injunction and the claim is covered by Guddi Kesarwani, the Executive Engineer’s rejection of a temporary electricity connection is set aside and remitted; if the petitioner applies for a commercial connection, it is to be processed in accordance with law.

not_decided.point: Merits of entitlement to a commercial or temporary connection
not_decided.note: Rejection set aside and remitted; a commercial connection is to be processed in accordance with law if the petitioner applies.

not_decided.point: Whether clause 7.10 is an efficacious alternative remedy barring the writ
not_decided.note: Raised as a preliminary objection; the Court proceeded on Guddi Kesarwani and remitted without ruling on maintainability.
